parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The client ID if you set IdentityType to CLIENT.

parameters.name: IdentityType
parameters.description:
The identity type. Valid values:

*   USER
*   CLIENT

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt delete-custom-auth-identity --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --username test --identity-type USER --client-id GID_test@@@test --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun onsmqtt DeleteCustomAuthIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'post-cn-0pp12gl0000' --Username test --ClientId 'GID_test@@@test'
